description: 한국지역난방공사_일자 및 시간대별 기상예측정보조회 서비스 [district heating] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국지역난방공사. 조회시작일, 조회종료일을 검색조건으로 하여 일자별로 외기온도, 풍속, 습도, 강수 등의 기상예측정보를 제공하는 기상예측정보 조회 서비스. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국지역난방공사. Its tags are 지역난방, 기상예측, 날씨정보, 외기온도, 풍속. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
